claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the original PlayStation 4 model with the 'PS4' logo embossed on the top right.
Photo 0 shows two controllers alongside the console.
The witness noted smudges and dust; functionality and internal condition are not shown.

risks.risk: Internal storage capacity is the minimum 500GB rather than 1TB.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the 'System Storage Management' screen in settings.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be faulty and unable to read games.
risks.proof: A video showing a disc being inserted, recognized, and launching a game.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

risks.risk: The controllers may have 'stick drift' or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controllers being used to navigate menus or a gameplay clip.

risks.risk: The console may overheat or have excessive fan noise due to internal dust/dry thermal paste.
risks.proof: A video of the console running a demanding game for at least 10 minutes.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and navigating the menu.
Screenshot of the System Information screen showing storage capacity.
Video of a game disc being loaded and played.
Photo of the rear ports to check for damage or tampering with warranty seals.
Confirmation that all necessary cables (Power, HDMI, Charging) are included.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a PS4 Fat with two controllers. It can be priced at the worst-case scenario for this specific model until functionality and storage are proven.
